title: Chapter 2738 - 99: Taotie Law (2)
content:
Chapter 2738: Chapter 99: Taotie Law (2)

This Big Tiger, has become the "source" of the Barbaric Tiger Demon bloodline?

Mo Hua thought about it and felt... a bit amazed.

The battle between the Taoist Court and the Great Wilderness gave himself the opportunity to manipulate things from the wilderness’s rear, and also gave the Big Tiger the chance to become the true king of ten thousand tigers.

But then, the tiger he raised... isn’t it a bit too flirtatious?

A person as pure and upright as himself, raising a flirtatious Big Tiger?

Mo Hua felt a bit strange inside.

Flirtatious Big Tiger...

Thinking of this, Mo Hua had an idea.

Why not name the Big Tiger "Dahu"? It’s from the "Big" generation, with patterns on its body, and quite "flirtatious."

But then Mo Hua thought again, whether one is flirtatious, this is a matter for humans.

The Big Tiger is a demon, naturally won’t care about these "human" concepts.

Even the Big Tiger itself is hazy; it probably doesn’t care whether other tigers are male or female.

After all, they are "kindred," living together is nothing.

The Big Tiger itself is innocent, it’s not it wanted to be flirtatious, it doesn’t even know what "flirtatious" means.

To say it is flirtatious, really does it a disservice.

But Mo Hua still decided, to call it "Dahu."

In the future, when he has the chance, he will take Dahu out to conquer the lands, and incidentally let Dahu produce a bunch of tiger cubs, forming an incredibly strong "father-son tiger army"...

Mo Hua happily patted the head of the Big Tiger:

"From now on, you will be called ’Dahu.’"

The Big Tiger snorted coldly, seemingly very disdainful of the name.

Mo Hua grilled some meat for it again, personally feeding it to eat, and only then did it reluctantly accept Mo Hua calling it "Dahu."

In front of grilled meat, what name it’s called isn’t that important.

After all, names are called by humans, what do they have to do with it, a tiger?

In the small cave, Mo Hua stayed with the Big Tiger for a while and then was about to leave.

The Big Tiger was a bit reluctant, it hummed twice toward Mo Hua, seemingly telling Mo Hua to remember to come see it when he has time.

It wanted to eat grilled meat together with Mo Hua, rather than play with a female tiger.

Mo Hua felt both amused and moved.

In this entire Wildland, only this Big Tiger counts as the "relative" he has known since childhood.

Mo Hua rubbed the Big Tiger’s neck, then turned and left.

...

After leaving the Wutu Deep Mountains, Mo Hua returned to the Wutu Tribe.

He first called Elder Zamu, telling him that there are very "dangerous" things within the deep mountains, absolutely not to approach, once entered, certain death awaits.

This is not a lie.

The Big Tiger is friendly to him, but only to him; other cultivators, in its eyes, are just ordinary walking "two-legged beasts."

Other female tigers, especially that Third Grade Dangling Eyes Fierce Tiger, need not be mentioned.

They will surely eat people.

Entering the Wutu Deep Mountains recklessly, even Golden Core cultivators will die inside.

Elder Zamu’s face showed extreme fear.

"But as long as we don’t enter the deep mountains, there won’t be any major problems, the dangers in the deep mountains remain inside and won’t come out." Mo Hua added.

Only then did Elder Zamu breathe a sigh of relief.

The matter of the Big Tiger is temporarily settled, Mo Hua also had to start considering the future development of the Wutu Mountain Realm, including the Dan Zhu forces.

The biggest hidden danger currently is still the "famine disaster."

This is not only for the Wutu Mountain Realm, but likely for the entire Barbaric Wilderness.

But this kind of "famine disaster," for now Mo Hua hasn’t seen through and has no good way to deal with it.

He can only send people to guard at the border of Wutu and Wusha Mountain Realm, once plants wither and flesh decays, report to him immediately.

This matter is more important than anything else.

The "famine disaster line" is very likely the "death line" for the Great Wilderness in the future.

Besides this, Mo Hua also sent people to nearby state boundaries to inquire about the Bi Fang Tribe, including the movements of other Third Grade Mountain Realm tribes.

Once the famine disaster spreads, tribal wars will start, chaos will happen frequently.

There will surely be many tribal barbarian soldiers wandering around, fighting, even plundering and slaughtering.

These are hidden dangers, have to be prevented.

This is also an inevitable matter.

And as Dan Zhu is the young master, he is also worried about the future of the Danque Tribe.

He doesn’t know whether the Bi Fang Tribe’s gathering of troops is solely aimed at him or if they want to engage in a great battle with the Danque Tribe.

Therefore, he wants to find a way to return to the Danque Tribe for support.

Mo Hua advised him: "Worrying about this matter won’t help. You are only in the Initial Golden Core phase..."

Speaking of this, Mo Hua paused, feeling complicated but still looking profound as he continued:

"You are only in the Initial Golden Core phase; you can’t help much in a large tribe’s decisive battle. Helping in small-scale conflicts doesn’t have much significance either."

"The priority is to first establish oneself, preserve life, seek survival, and strive for strength. Once you become stronger yourself and your forces become powerful, you can do more things."

Dan Zhu knew that Mr. Witch has always been accurate in his predictions, so he felt more at ease and nodded: "Yes, gentleman."

Mo Hua thought for a moment, then called Little Zatu, letting him follow Dan Zhu as a small follower, doing some small tasks closely.

Someone can accompany Dan Zhu, and Little Zatu following him may potentially have a good future too, which is a win-win situation.

Upon learning this, Elder Zamu was even more grateful to Mo Hua.

His greatest worry was his little grandson Zatu; now Zatu has a "bright path," Elder Zamu feels he can die with no regrets, even to die for Mr. Witch now would be worthwhile.

...

All related trivial matters were arranged.

Despite the famine disaster rampant outside, within the Wutu Mountain Realm, due to its secluded location, there was a momentary appearance of peace and harmony.
